exposure: deepest vertical pocket of amniotic fluid
cohort: The study included 195 patients delivered in a hospital with a prenatal diagnosis of polyhydramnios during pregnancy.
finding: Genetic testing and clinical examination identified a chromosomal or genetic disease in 13.3% of cases, with a deepest vertical pocket of amniotic fluid of >=13.0 cm and reduced fetal movements being significant predictors of a genetic disorder.
